scope: 2022Q1-2023Q2 archived Seoul P0; decisions at SRC->validated-staging boundary, no DIM/FACT loading

general.raw_retention: NEVER modify/delete SRC raw strings or source JSON
general.number_cast: Decimal; reject malformed or nonfinite; integer counts must be integral; preserve strings at SRC
general.period: accept only ^(19|20)[0-9]{2}[1-4]$, convert to YYYYQq only in validated output
general.missing: NULL remains unknown, never fill zero by default
general.dedup: source hash + key + publication version; within-file duplicate business keys quarantine
general.source_tracking: record batch and source path per validated/rejected row

rules.condition: missing business key, duplicate (key within version), malformed row count, unexpected CSV header, invalid period code
nonnumeric required metric, negative strictly nonnegative KPI, or fractional integer count

rules.action: retain original values; flag; do not cap or delete
retain; counts have potentially different population definitions; no automatic correction
retain in SRC; verify definitions/business dimensions before enforcing hierarchy in FACT

rules.condition: store_count=0, events occur; event count exceeds snapshot count; zero rate but positive events
rules.action: report; do not alter rates or counts; validate snapshot and aggregation periods

rules.condition: sex/age detail total differs from overall sales
rules.action: retain full amount; do not overwrite amount with demographic sum (company vs individual transactions may differ)

rules.condition: time-of-day transaction count sum differs from total, or negative time-bin transaction count
rules.action: exclude invalid breakdown from granular analytics until official source correction; base aggregate can remain eligible

rules.condition: no officially verified area effective start date/spatial boundary version
rules.action: SRC validated only; no DIM_AREA generated dates; no FACT area_key inference

rules.condition: STORE has no matching SALES grain
rules.action: LEFT JOIN store->sales; sales NULL, never treat as 0 or drop store rows
original 당월_매출_금액 interpreted as quarterly estimated KRW for audited OA-15572 only; no /3 or *3; require area SCD provenance before FACT

rules.condition: same area code has inconsistent name/type
rules.action: join only on verified code and spatial version; preserve raw name; no automatic name replacements

rules.condition: decomposed amount by weekday/weekend, day, time should reconcile to total
rules.action: when mismatch flag input; avoid overwriting total; investigate source release and rounding

rules.condition: FTC and Seoul industry codes not mapped with versioned crosswalk
rules.action: P0 DIM_INDUSTRY may use Seoul taxonomy; FTC mapping held
